answer: We enforce a quadratic staking erosion model where validator collateral is locked within an isolated liquidity island to deter nimble capital withdrawal. By integrating zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, the marginal cost of compute scales super-linearly, transforming a complex sonnet of coordinated node deployment into a prohibitive financial burden. This mechanism drives the net expected utility toward a terminal nadir as slashing penalties exceed total extractable value, sustaining a Nash equilibrium where honest participation is the optimal strategy.
